fields.description: Turn the WhatsApp integration on or off globally.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: WuzAPI admin token (WUZAPI_ADMIN_TOKEN) - used to create per-instance sessions
fields.label: WuzAPI Admin Token

fields.description: Protect the WhatsApp number from being banned: pace outgoing messages, verify recipients, cap daily volume and warm up new instances.
fields.label: Enable Anti-Ban Protection

fields.description: Check each recipient via WuzAPI /user/check before the send. Numbers not registered on WhatsApp are skipped - messaging dead numbers is a strong spam signal.
fields.label: Verify Numbers Exist on WhatsApp

fields.description: Instances younger than 3 weeks get a ramped daily limit (20 → 50 → 100 → 150) regardless of the configured cap. New numbers sending at volume are banned fastest.
fields.label: Warm Up New Instances

fields.description: Minimum pause between consecutive messages in broadcasts and queue drains.
fields.label: Min Delay Between Messages (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum pause - the actual delay is randomized between min and max so the sending pattern doesn't look mechanical.
fields.label: Max Delay Between Messages (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum messages per instance per day. Messages over the cap are queued and sent the next day. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Daily Message Limit (per instance)
